description: HCP Backup and Restore user-journey SLO dashboard (ARO-29950).

options.content:
### HCP Backup & Restore SLO Dashboard

User-journey dashboard for Velero-managed HCP backups on management clusters. Baseline panels follow **ARO-29950** and mirror the current SLO/alert thresholds from **ARO-29948 / ARO-26261**.

| SLI | Dashboard interpretation | Objective / threshold |
|-----|---------------------------|-----------------------|
| **Availability** | 6-hourly backup freshness per HostedCluster | every selected HC fresh within **12h** (24h/72h escalation) |
| **Errors** | failed completed outcomes / all completed outcomes | **< 0.5%** failures / **99.5%** success over 30d |
| **Latency** | completed backup duration p50/p95/p99 | **p99 < 20m** |
| **Traffic** | backup attempt rate vs 1d baseline | no sustained drop below **10%** of baseline |
| **Saturation** | non-terminal backup backlog + data-upload health | backlog should not stay **>10** for 3.5h |

**Scope:** Prometheus service datasources and management clusters. Selecting an HCP Namespace scopes Availability / Errors / Latency / Traffic. Storage Availability and Saturation stay management-cluster-wide because those are fleet proxy signals.

**Known gaps:** Storage Availability and repo-maintenance Saturation are proxy signals pending ARO-29949. Snapshot-specific panels wait for ARO-29444. Restore SLIs are deferred until restore activity is exercised and instrumented.

**Drilldown:** use the HCP Namespace selector and the per-HCP tables at the bottom. Component-level details remain in the existing Velero dashboard (`ozk-vlr-mon`).

panels.description: Percent of selected 6-hourly HCP schedules whose last successful backup is no more than 12 hours old. Operational target: 100%.
panels.title: Freshness Coverage (≤12h)

targets.expr: (1-(((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_partial_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_validation_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0)))/((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_success_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_partial_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_validation_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0)))))*100

panels.description: Remaining 0.5% failure budget over 30 days. 100% means no budget consumed; 0% means exhausted.
